editionLabel: Thames & Kosmos original English edition, item 696116
firstPlayerRule: The youngest player begins. Play then proceeds clockwise.
houseFallback: If two or more players are equally youngest, choose among them at random. This is a house-rule suggestion, not a publisher instruction.
clarifications: This answer covers the manual's standard game for two to four players; the solitaire and partnership variants are separate.
Thames & Kosmos lists a separate second-edition manual for the same item number. This answer cites the original manual only.
